core_obligations: Build the inverse system of short exact sequences computing H^p(K_n) from the description of K_n as a shift of the cone on f^n, and pass to the inverse limit to obtain the top row (proof lines 26959-26975).
Compare the truncation L of K with K and the corresponding systems L_n and K_n to identify the rows of the diagram (proof lines 26975-26990).
Verify the commutativity of the diagram and the exactness of the columns by the long exact sequence of a principal ideal (proof lines 26990-26999).
Conclude the existence of the diagram with exact rows and columns asserted in the statement (proof lines 26999-27000).
proof_roadmap: Construct the inverse system and take its limit for the top row (proof lines 26959-26975).
Use the truncation to identify the two rows (proof lines 26975-26990).
Check commutativity and exactness of the columns (proof lines 26990-27000).
difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs a commutative diagram with exact rows and columns comparing the f-adic completion of the cohomology of a complex with its derived completion along a principal ideal, and the proof is a 42-line argument. It first builds the inverse system of short exact sequences computing the cohomology of the complexes K_n from the cone construction and passes to inverse limits using the Mittag-Leffler condition; then it compares the truncation of the complex with the original one to identify the two rows of the diagram, and finally reads the exactness of the columns off the long exact sequence of a principal ideal. The construction of the diagram and the two identifications are all carried out in the source.
